updates.name: [BaseApp] Unified Input File Map Loading
updates.description: Refactored DataLoader to build a key:path map first and run one concurrent loading flow for single files and folders alike, using basenames for direct file inputs and relative paths for folder inputs.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Single File Input Basename Keys
updates.description: Updated single-file config.input loading to keep results keyed by file basename, for example updates.base.json, instead of using the dummy '.' key or returning the payload directly.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Single File Input Shape Fix
updates.description: Kept updates/base.json as a config.input source and removed the dummy '.' key from single-file loads by keying file results explicitly instead.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Recursive JSON Field Materialization
updates.description: Updated output serialization to recursively parse JSON-like string fields (including DataFrame rows) into native objects and added parse diagnostics (BASE011/BASEW11).

updates.name: [BaseApp] Message Codes And Project-Dir Pathing
updates.description: Switched default message dictionary paths to docs/message_codes and aligned relative path resolution to the app/project directory for logger message lookup and config.input DataLoader sources.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Generic Input Data Loader
updates.description: Added load_data flow to process all config.input entries where load=true, storing each dataset under results.{target} with file and folder path support.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Script Message Lookup Paths
updates.description: Fixed instantiate and pullbase messages_dir resolution to load message CSVs from config-relative docs/messages so message code text/type lookup works.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Logger Init Fallback
updates.description: Added explicit console output when pullbase logger initialization fails, preventing silent logging disablement.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Trackit Runtime Orchestration
updates.description: Introduced Config runtime loader, renamed decorator to trackit, and updated run() to initialize config/logger then log execute tracking output with function, result, and metrics.duration_seconds.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Run Timeit Decorator
updates.description: Added a reusable timeit decorator and applied it to run() so total runtime is logged with message code BASE005.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Logger Data Column
updates.description: Updated Logger.log signature to use data payload and store caller key:value metadata in a single CSV data column instead of dynamic parsed columns.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Logger Dynamic Fields
updates.description: Added Logger.log fields support so caller-supplied key:value data is mapped to dynamic CSV columns and populated only on relevant rows.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Local App Logs
updates.description: Updated pullbase logging to use local app identity and output path C:/data/{local_app}/{date}/basepulls/{local_app}_{timestamp}.(csv|html).

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Base Config Only
updates.description: Updated instantiate runtime config loading to use only base.json (no app.json override) for path and logging resolution.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Fixed Log Path
updates.description: Updated instantiate logging output to C:/data/BaseApp/instantiations/{date}/{target_app}_{timestamp}.csv and matching HTML path.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Pullbase Logging
updates.description: Added CSV+HTML logging to instantiate (base logs_path/instantiations, {target_app}_{timestamp}) and pullbase (app logs_path/basepulls, {base_app}_{timestamp}).

updates.name: [BaseApp] Manifest Folder Source Sync
updates.description: Added support for manifest entries whose source is a folder; instantiate and pullbase now sync all files recursively with optional target folder mapping.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Key Driven Manifest Folder
updates.description: Updated instantiate and pullbase to consume all JSON files from docs/manifests and apply behavior by key: instantiate uses once+pull, pullbase uses pull.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Manifest Source Target Schema
updates.description: Updated instantiate and pullbase manifest parsing to use section lists of items with required source and optional target defaulting to source.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Scripts And Manifest Dict
updates.description: Moved instantiate and pullbase into scripts/ and updated manifests to dict format with pull and once sections under docs/manifests.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Manifest Location Refactor
updates.description: Moved instantiate and pull manifests to docs/manifests (pull.json and once.json) and updated instantiate.py and pullbase.py to consume the new paths.
